name: inferCSN CRAN core
method_summary: This integration runs the public CRAN inferCSN 1.2.0 sparse-regression core once on the supplied expression matrix. ANDREA can invoke that same global core independently for each group. It does not implement the paper's broader pseudotime/state-window/reference-network workflow. The optional max filter calls the public CRAN network_sift().

threading.upstream_mapping: Wrapper maps ANDREA --threads to inferCSN::inferCSN(cores=threads) and inferCSN::network_sift(cores=threads) for sift_method=max. The wrapper pins common BLAS/OpenMP environment variables to 1 to avoid nested parallelism; current cost profiles cover 1, 2, 4 and 8 assigned threads.

optional.usage: Wrapper validates tf_list.txt against expression genes and passes it as inferCSN regulators; if absent, the wrapper omits regulators to preserve inferCSN's all-gene default.

conditional_required.message: groups is required when execution.mode=group_emulated because ANDREA partitions expression columns before invoking the inferCSN global core.
conditional_required.usage: ANDREA uses groups.tsv to create one group-specific expression matrix per physical global inferCSN run; the child container does not receive the file.

progress.note: inferCSN iterates over target genes internally but does not expose a stable fine-grained callback to ANDREA; the wrapper reports coarse lifecycle states in progress.json.

penalty.description: Sparse regression penalty passed to inferCSN(). Upstream documents L0, L0L1 and L0L2, with L0 as the default.

cross_validation.description: Whether inferCSN should use L0Learn cross-validation when fitting each target-gene sparse regression model.

seed.description: Random seed passed to inferCSN for cross-validation and subsampling. Values are restricted to R's non-missing signed-integer range.

n_folds.description: Number of folds passed to L0Learn cross-validation when cross_validation=true.

subsampling_method.description: Upstream subsampling strategy used before sparse regression when subsampling_ratio < 1.

subsampling_ratio.description: Fraction of cells used by inferCSN subsampling. A value of 1 preserves the full input matrix and skips subsampling.

r_squared_threshold.description: Minimum model R2 required before retaining normalized target-gene coefficients; targets with R2 at or below this threshold yield zero coefficients that are omitted from network.csv.

sift_method.description: Optional public post-inference filter. none preserves the inferCSN() table; max calls inferCSN::network_sift(method="max") to keep the stronger reciprocal direction.

artifacts_aux.description: Combined stdout/stderr log from the inferCSN run.
Raw regulator-target-weight table returned by inferCSN() before optional post-inference filtering.
Final regulator-target-weight table after applying the selected public upstream filter and before conversion to ANDREA network.csv.
